review_role: Independent second agent; observed metadata and evidence directly. Parent conclusions not treated as facts.
git_mutation_exception: Parent created one audit worktree/branch before scan. This reviewer only reads Git metadata; no fetch/gc/prune/repack performed.

findings.claim: Immediate retirement/move of nested old clone B
findings.evidence: harness objects/info/alternates directly points at B/objects; 15536 accessible objects are not physically stored in harness.
findings.remedy: Keep B at current path. Future separate authorized migration must materialize and validate complete object closure before alternate removal.

findings.claim: Retire dirty worktrees or old polyp project
findings.evidence: 19 tracked modifications across four roots; untracked and ignored source/results/checkpoints remain.
findings.remedy: Preserve snapshot, provenance, owner review, and recovery test before any proposal.

findings.claim: Retire clean historical worktrees merely because commits are pushed
findings.evidence: All historical working trees contain ignored scientific assets except harness_main_ready; clean status is not unique-asset absence.
findings.remedy: Per-asset hash/dependency closure, external data rebinding and cold archive restore validation required.

findings.claim: Mother polyp repository is fully synchronized
findings.evidence: ls-remote returned128; remote live state unverified, local tracking refs insufficient.
findings.remedy: Read-only remote access repair and later tip/ancestry verification.

findings.claim: MAE improvement proves 3D world placement and all geometric metrics improve
findings.evidence: Different SE3 frames; G01 MAE improves only independent frame while fixed frame worsens, Fscore and coverage also decrease.
findings.remedy: Keep all protocols separate and paired on fixed denominators.

findings.claim: Sampled existing hardlinks have identical bytes and must be counted once
findings.evidence: 16 actual same-inode pairs have recomputed SHA256 equality.
findings.remedy: No deletion authorization; no new disk savings claimed.

findings.claim: Delete unreferenced/dangling objects or LFS as cache
findings.evidence: All five fsck checks returned0 but unreferenced physical objects exist; no audit of their scientific content establishes disposability.
findings.remedy: Retain exact stores including refs/reflogs and dangling material.

findings.evidence: Snapshot status has0 tracked changes,0 untracked,0 ignored, yet global absolute-path and recovery closure still required.
findings.remedy: Potential candidate after full dependency check; current task authorizes no retirement.

findings.evidence: Independent SQLite query finds53263 symlinks but first export has0 entries: WHERE kind="symlink" resolves right side as existing symlink column in SQLite.
findings.remedy: Export with parameterized value or single-quoted SQL string; retain finding and corrected count.

findings.claim: Extension-based value labels certify raw origin or global uniqueness
findings.evidence: category() labels all blend/video UNIQUE_RAW_DATA and pt/ckpt UNIQUE_MODEL_WEIGHT without source-role proof; may include synthetic scenes and repeated checkpoints.
findings.remedy: Mark classification as conservative protection heuristic, not semantic or uniqueness certification. Unknown stays preserved.

limitations: Hash sample confirms only listed pairs, not whole asset inventory.
Remote ancestry for absent local remote objects cannot be established without fetch; no fetch permitted by read-only-source approach.
Objectsize disk representation bytes cannot be interpreted as reclaimable pack allocation.
Global unique-assets claims require parent inventory cross-check, not filename comparisons.
